modules.title: 从 0 到 1 使用 Skill

install.title: Skill 怎么安装
install.lead: 把仓库地址和 Skill 所在路径一起发给 Agent，让它完成下载、安装和检查。
install.prompt:
https://github.com/oil-oil/vibe-hub-skill
帮我安装这个仓库里的 skills/vibehub Skill。
sources: 别人发来的本地文件夹
install.usagePrompt: 使用 VibeHub，帮我学懂 Git Branch。
install.usageNote: 你可以直接点名 Skill，也可以只描述任务，让 Agent 判断是否需要使用。
install.boundary: 不同 Agent 保存 Skill 的位置可能不同，安装时让当前 Agent 自己确认。

value.title: Skill 的作用
value.lead: Skill 主要解决两件事：把重复做法固定下来，再把需要的知识和文件交给 Agent。

creation.title: Skill 怎么创建
creation.lead: 不用从空白格式开始，直接让 Agent 使用 Skill Creator 生成第一版。
creation.prompt: 使用 Skill Creator，帮我创建一个「发布视频」Skill。先问我它要解决什么问题，再生成第一版。
steps: 告诉 AI 这个 Skill 要解决什么问题
让 Skill Creator 生成第一版
用真实任务测试，再继续修改

test.title: Skill 怎么测试
test.lead: 让有 Skill 和没有 Skill 的 Agent 做同一个任务，再直接比较结果。
test.task: 把 12 条项目记录整理成周报
test.without: 只提供任务和原始记录，让 Agent 自己决定步骤。
test.with: 提供同样的任务和记录，同时让 Agent 使用周报 Skill。
test.boundary: 支持 Sub-agent 时可以并行测试；不支持时，就开两个独立对话。

practices.title: Skill 的最佳实践
practices.lead: Skill 是给 AI 读的，所以要短、清楚、容易执行。

topics.label: 描述写清楚
topics.detail: 说明这个 Skill 做什么，以及什么任务应该使用它。

topics.label: 固定步骤用程序
topics.detail: 能用程序稳定完成的动作，就不要让 Agent 每次重新走一遍。

topics.label: 信息保持精简
topics.detail: 只保留完成任务需要的信息，减少无用内容和 token 消耗。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Skill 提供做事方法和相关文件，不会自动获得账号、平台或其他外部系统的权限。

lessonPractice.title: 团队每周都让 Agent 按同一规则生成发布说明，还要复用脚本和模板。怎样减少重复教学？

options.label: 建立带 SKILL.md 入口的 Skill，并收纳触发规则、步骤、脚本和模板
options.feedback: 稳定流程和配套资源有明确入口后，Agent 能在对应任务中重复采用同一套做法。

options.label: 只保存一句“生成高质量发布说明”，每次让 Agent 自行猜格式
options.feedback: 一句目标没有执行步骤、模板和验收条件，输出仍会随每次上下文变化。

options.label: 把所有项目聊天记录都塞进说明文件，不区分触发任务和长期规则
options.feedback: 无关历史会稀释稳定流程，也让 Skill 难以判断何时和怎样使用资源。

en.title: Every week, a team teaches an Agent the same release-note rules and reuses scripts and templates. How can repetition be reduced?

options.label: Create a Skill with a SKILL.md entry plus triggers, steps, scripts, and templates
options.feedback: A clear entry to a stable workflow and resources lets the Agent reuse the same method for matching tasks.

options.label: Save only Write high-quality release notes and let the Agent infer the format each time
options.feedback: One goal provides no procedure, template, or acceptance criteria, so output still varies with context.

options.label: Put every project chat into the instruction file without separating triggers from durable rules
options.feedback: Irrelevant history dilutes the stable process and obscures when and how resources should be used.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把每周发布说明流程整理成 Skill：SKILL.md 写清触发条件、输入、步骤和验收，脚本与模板放在对应目录。只保留稳定规则，不复制临时聊天；用一份真实改动验证可重复执行。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Package the weekly release-note workflow as a Skill: define triggers, inputs, steps, and acceptance in SKILL.md and keep scripts and templates in their directories. Exclude temporary chat and verify repeatability on a real change set.

learning.assumes: You have repeatedly given an AI agent the same steps, template, or review rules.
learning.outcome: You can inspect, install, use, create, and test a Skill folder.

modules.title: Use a Skill from start to finish

install.title: How to install a Skill
install.lead: Send the repository address and the Skill path to your agent so it can download, install, and check it.
install.prompt:
https://github.com/oil-oil/vibe-hub-skill
Install the skills/vibehub Skill from this repository.
sources: A local folder shared by someone else
install.usagePrompt: Use VibeHub to help me understand Git Branch.
install.usageNote: You can name the Skill directly or describe the task and let the agent decide whether it applies.
install.boundary: Different agents can store Skills in different places. Ask the current agent to confirm its location during installation.

value.title: What a Skill does
value.lead: A Skill mainly solves two problems: it preserves a repeatable method and gives the agent the knowledge and files it needs.

creation.title: How to create a Skill
creation.lead: Do not start from a blank format. Ask Skill Creator to generate a first version.
creation.prompt: Use Skill Creator to create a Video Publishing Skill. Ask what problem it should solve first, then generate a first version.
steps: Tell the AI what problem the Skill should solve
Ask Skill Creator for a first version
Test it on real work, then improve it

test.title: How to test a Skill
test.lead: Give the same task to an agent with the Skill and to one without it, then compare the results directly.
test.task: Turn 12 project updates into a weekly report
test.without: Give the task and raw updates only; let the agent choose its own method.
test.with: Give the same task and updates, and tell the agent to use the weekly-report Skill.
test.boundary: If the platform supports subagents, test in parallel. Otherwise, use two separate conversations.

practices.title: Skill best practices
practices.lead: Skills are read by AI, so keep them short, clear, and executable.

topics.label: Write a clear description
topics.detail: State what the Skill does and what tasks should use it.

topics.label: Put repeatable steps in code
topics.detail: If a program can complete an action reliably, do not make the agent rediscover it every time.

topics.label: Keep the information lean
topics.detail: Keep only what is needed to complete the task and reduce unnecessary token use.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A Skill provides a method and related files; it does not automatically grant access to accounts, platforms, or external systems.

distinctions.label: Plugin
distinctions.text: A {c:skill} is a specialized workflow and knowledge bundle for AI agents; a {c:plugin} is a software code package extending native commands and UI in the host application.
